applicant.name: Dr. Lena Gruber
applicant.organisation: Medical University of Innsbruck, cardiology research group

purpose: Scientific research on stroke prevention: we study which anticoagulant treatment sequences in older patients with atrial fibrillation are followed by hospital stays. Statistics are not enough: the analysis needs each patient's treatment history over time.
question: Provide pseudonymised diagnoses, medications and hospital stays for patients aged 65 or older with atrial fibrillation.
definitions: Atrial fibrillation = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I48.
Cohort = patients aged 65 or older on 31 December 2025 with atrial fibrillation.
Report the size of the cohort you would make available.
